items.summary: Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan vacated MD & CEO position; Mr. Anup Bagchi appointed as new MD & CEO.
HDFC Bank informed about the grant of 1302379 options.
Transcript of earnings call for quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 made available.
HDFC Bank informed about allotment of 9138522 shares.
HDFC Bank published newspaper confirming dispatch of Postal Ballot Notice.
HDFC Bank provided notice of Postal Ballot for shareholder approval.
Audio recording of earnings call for quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 made available.
Board approved re-appointment of Mrs. Lily Vadera as Independent Director for three years.
Presentation for earnings call regarding financial results for quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 made available.
HDFC Bank submitted financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
